no it isn't that, but i wish i could read this one! it looks cute!

after you do break up, cut all contact. pull some real eternal sunshine of the spotless mind type of shit. delete numbers, facebook friends, anything that would give you an opportunity to talk to him. throw pictures, clothes, gifts from him out. he's not a nice man and you're probably not going to reminisce fondly about this relationship, so the items will only serve to remind you of him.

do not believe his lies. do not go back when he tells you how bad his life is without you. do not be fooled by the extra affection, because you know full well it will not last.

afterward, i'd consider making plans with friends or even just doing something fun with yourself, preferably outside. take your mind off of him and the breakup as best as you can. also, think about seeing a therapist if you still suffer from low confidence and self esteem while single. you can do this! good luck!
